text: implementer agent has no Skill tool, so a handoff saying 'load the code-conventions skill' silently fails and the agent reports the skill does not exist; handoffs must say 'read ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md' instead, or the agent definition should preload it

PLAN.md was committed to personal-site despite the global /PLAN.md ignore (ignore rules don't apply to already-tracked files); a plan-skill check of 'git ls-files --error-unmatch PLAN.md' before writing would have caught it

The worktrees skill puts worktrees under <repo>/.claude/worktrees/, but nothing ignores that path, so the main checkout shows '?? .claude/worktrees/'; adding .claude/worktrees/ to the stowed global gitignore would prevent it
